thread:
anya: Heads-up 4 quick IA tweak proposal: group left rail into Workspace / Deployments / Models / Observability. Goal: clearer mental model for users switching between model work and runtime ops. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz
marta: looks good. One concern: deep links. If someone shares a link to a model version, should the rail expand and highlight that model?

devon: prefer expand+highlight visually, but do NOT move keyboard focus into the rail on load. Focus should be H1 and provide a skip-to-nav link.

ada-a11y: agreed. Also add an aria-live polite region announcing breadcrumb on load: "You are on: Acme / Models / T-Rex v1.2". Permalink menu needs aria-haspopup and clear aria-label.

pete: engineering: we'll maintain a small nav-route map (server-rendered) mapping path patterns to nav IDs so expansion is deterministic. Example: /w/:slug/models/:id -> nav-models. We'll also canonicalize legacy query-style URLs to new path form via a router shim.

anya: copy note: breadcrumb pieces should be humanized: "Acme Workspace > Models > T-Rex (v1.2)". Truncate long names with ellipsis and full name on hover + accessible name.

marta: analytics: tag initial loads with load_source=deep_link|nav so we can separate bookmarked traffic from in-app nav. Also track nav.group_open events.

design-bot: Follow-up: create "nav route map" doc and tag eng+a11y. (reaction: :bell:)

anya: action items: devon to implement focus/skip-link pattern; pete to add nav map + router shim; ada-a11y to draft aria copy; marta to add analytics spec. I'll update Figma and share tickets.
